# UsageMeter

Consumption against a plan limit, shown calmly: used, what is left, a warning near the limit, a controlled block at the limit, and the upgrade.

`Ventora.UsageMeter` · Feedback

## Use

```jsx
<Ventora.UsageMeter label="…" used={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Ventora.UsageMeter" label="…" used="{{0}}"></x-import>
```
